mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate contracting consumer demand, signaling reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recoveries, unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-recession recoveries when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and unemployment rate indicate labor market contraction, reducing consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC for joint signal < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production indicates strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
